scope: Explicit fixed native hand-skin selection for A/B geometry diagnostics
selection_basis: Sum of native MHR LBS weights on each hand joint range; vertices with hand weight >=0.5
evaluated_phase_policy: Independent evaluator measures all360frames with an all-ones phase mask, then reports all-frame and fixed pose-usable/manual-phase subsets. No released/unusable frames are silently discarded.
probe_label_correction: An unused display benchmark mislabeled this default threshold0.1. Its image/label did not select vertices for fitting, independent evaluation or the final all-native-triangle renderer.
geometry_interpretation: Selected native hand-skin vertex penetration into an uncertain reconstructed convex object; not full mesh intersection volume, actual contact truth or official PEN.
